---
title: "Moving to and from Ireland"
description: "How many people arrive in Ireland and leave it each year."
image: ../images/social/migration-flows.png
---

The Central Statistics Office estimates how many people move to Ireland and how many leave in each twelve months to April. In most years since the mid-1990s more people have arrived than left. More people left than arrived in most years from 1987 to 1995, and again from 2010 to 2014, after the financial crash.

Immigration was highest in the year to April 2007, when an estimated 151,100 people arrived. Emigration was highest in the year to April 2012, at 83,000.
